title: AI-Safe Execution Patch
description: Structured patch instruction for AI-driven code modification. Consumed by the AI-Safe Execution Infrastructure runtime.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '1.0' for this revision.

patch_id.description: Unique identifier for this patch. Used to correlate snapshots, logs, and rollback records.

action.description: Top-level action type. Determines which validation rules and execution path apply.

file.description: Relative path from project root to the target file. Must not be absolute.

symbol.description: Name of the function, class, or symbol to target. Required for symbol-level actions.

line_hint.description: Optional line number hint for disambiguation. Not used as the sole locator.

operation.description: The specific transformation to perform within the targeted symbol.

payload.description: Code content or structured diff payload. Max 64KB to prevent oversized patches.

context_before.description: For context_replace: lines before the change anchor. Used as a locator, not a line number.

context_after.description: For context_replace: lines after the change anchor.

imports.description: For update_import: list of import statements to add or remove.

constraints.description: Optional execution constraints applied to the sandbox. Defaults applied if omitted.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum execution time in milliseconds. Range: 100ms–30s.

memory_limit_mb.description: Maximum memory allocation in megabytes. Range: 8MB–2048MB.

allow_network.description: Whether the sandbox may make outbound network calls. Defaults to false (deny).

allow_filesystem.description: Whether the sandbox may read/write the filesystem outside its working directory. Defaults to false (deny).

sandbox_tier.description: Preferred sandbox tier. 'auto' selects the most secure available tier.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for observability and audit tracking.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the AI agent that generated this patch.

model.description: Name of the LLM/model that generated this patch.

intent.description: Human-readable description of the patch's intended effect. Used in audit logs.

ae_target.description: Optional Semantic Bridge block. When present, Gate 3 (SemanticGate) verifies stability before applying the patch. Omit for legacy string-based patching.

node_hash.description: BLAKE3 hex digest of the target AST node's ContentHash. Identifies the precise subtree to verify.

replacement_src.description: Aether source for the replacement node. Used by ae check --diff-impact to verify stability is not broken.

stability_required.description: If true, Gate 3 will reject the patch if the replacement introduces a Union type (instability).
